method.baseline: Executable saved from the working tree before this task; prior Metal implementation forced to metal-fp32. This was not a clean HEAD build.
method.measurement: Before then after, sequentially. No other build/test/benchmark ran during recorded final timing samples. Initial load, tokenizer cross-checks and a cancelled warm-up prefill excluded. Short: Hello., 21 input tokens, one output token plus one decode to stop. Long: 81 input tokens, first 12 output tokens. Medians of 5 short resident/auto samples or 3 long/stream samples.
method.precision: Both before and after use original BF16 weights with FP32 operands and accumulation. No additional quantization or FP16 rounding.
method.cache_caveat: 8b-auto-short had different startup memory budgets and retained weight amounts; its speedup includes reduced disk I/O and is not an isolated kernel comparison.

before.text: Translation quality depends on context, terminology, and the structure of the original document. A useful system should preserve numbers, dates, and product names while producing natural sentences. This benchmark compares the same full precision model on the CPU and the GPU. It measures the delay before the first output token and the time spent generating subsequent tokens, while checking the translated text and the numerical differences between the two implementations.

gpu_validation.coverage: FP32 projections; odd shapes, strides, tails, large resident projections in one command, cache shrink/grow, failed reads, restarts, fused MLP 0..65 tokens against CPU, cache miss/eviction leaves states unchanged.

model_free_tests.native: make test PASS; unavailable sandbox GPU explicitly skipped, then tested separately on GPU

limits: Six completed 2B translations and numeric probes are regression tests, not a broad translation-quality evaluation. GPU FP32 accumulation order differs from CPU; bitwise equivalence is not promised.
8B BF16 streaming is dominated by weight I/O. 31B translation was not measured; model-free profile and build coverage only.
Fanless M2, system memory pressure and OS scheduling affect timings; no thermal or power-state control.
